jobs_results.title: Analista programador en React o Node.js
jobs_results.description:
En Robot Farmacia buscamos un perfil freelance de desarrollador FrontEnd senior con al menos 5 años experiencia para trabajar desde nuestras oficinas o bien en remoto ( el 90% del tiempo).

REQUISITOS:
• Se requiere un amplio conocimiento y experiencia en las tecnologías web usando plataformas React o

"Nodej.js" (versiones modernas)
• Experiencia en diseño e implementación de interfaces de usuario.
• Conocimiento de las tecnologías en las que está basado React: HTML, CSS, JS y ecosistema.
• Dominio de las técnicas de creación de interfaces adaptables a diferentes plataformas y tamaños de pantalla.
• Experiencia con TypeScript y React Query si procede.
• Dominio de MySQL (a nivel de usuario y administrador con conocimientos profundos).
• Familiarizado con metodologías ágiles de desarrollo (SCRUM, Kanban...) y con el repositorio GitHub.
• Dominio del Ingles, nivel mínimo B2.
• Una de estas formaciones: ciclo superior aplic. web, grado Ingeniería Informática, matemáticas o física.
•... Residir en España

¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?
• Salario acorde al perfil.
• Ubicación 90% remota.
• Trabajar en un interesante proyecto del sector farmacéutico con futuro.
• Posibilidad de trabajar en nuevos proyectos.

Necesitamos una persona autónoma, trabajadora y proactiva a la que le gusten los retos.

Automatización Farmacétucia S.L es una empresa dedicada al sector de farmacia que está en plena expansión. Actualmente tenemos una amplia clientela y varias licitaciones de proyectos regionales.

Trabajamos con tecnologías de vanguardia y estratégicas en el mercado farmacéutico

jobs_results.title: Full-stack developer (react/node)
jobs_results.description:
Get a remote job that you will love with better compensation and career growth.

We’re Lemon.io — a marketplace where we match you with hand-picked startups from the US and Europe.

Why work with us:
- We’ll find you a team that respects you. No time-trackers or any micromanagement stuff
- Our engineers earn $6k - $10k / month. We’ve already paid out over $10M.
- Choose your schedule. We have both full- and part-time projects.
- No project managers in the middle — only direct communications with clients, most of whom have a technical background
- Our customer success team provides life support to help you resolve anything.
- You don’t have to look for clients and or negotiate anymore: just do what you do best and leave us the rest.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of software development experience
- Strong knowledge of JavaScript (Core, DOM APIs)
- 3+ years of experience with Node.js
- Experience with front-end JavaScript frameworks and libraries (React.js preferably)
- Understanding of and... practical experience with SOLID principles and GOF patterns
- Understanding of CI principles
- Experience with Typescript and React Native would be a plus

- Good command of English, both written and spoken, as you’ll be communicating with clients directly
- Strong organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision
- Responsibility — we want to trust you
- Soft skills — we don’t ask you find a topic for a small talk, but being just polite is OK

Apply today, and our team will get back to you within 2 business days

jobs_results.title: Senior node.js
jobs_results.description:
At intive we believe that emerging digital technologies make life easier. Therefore, with more than 3000 people on board we help forward-thinking enterprises to design and build smart applications, software solutions and turn ideas into digital reality all around the world. To achieve the best results, we are constantly challenging assumptions and establishing new approaches.

You are a good match if you have:

- Hands-on experience in various applications including micro-services using industry-leading frameworks and design patterns, as well as good knowledge of software development and systems architecture.
- Experience with JavaScript and Node.js technology stack ideally with Typescript.
- Experience with Docker and containers.
- Actively developed and designed REST APIs.
- Proven knowledge of AWS and/or other public cloud providers like Azure, Google.
- Practiced contemporary software development methodologies: Agile, Scrum, XP, etc. with strong focus on application security... performance & maintainability.

You get extra points for:

- Knowledge of Container orchestration and Distributed Systems.
- Knowledge of GraphQL.

What you will be doing:

- Back-end development.
- Working with other team members of different profiles (QA, Product Owner, Scrum Master, back-end and front-end developers) to deliver shippable parts in a steady pace project.

Why intive?

We cultivate an environment where innovative ideas and excellence have room to thrive - even with a remote workforce. Our culture of learning rewards curiosity and gives our team members opportunities to learn, grow, and own the evolution of their careers.

- Remote Work, Flexibility & Balance – We work 100% remotely.

- Career Path Planning – You can create a career path based on your goals. We provide training and support to help you along the way.

- Training & Mentorship – Learning and Development is a big part of our company culture. You will have access to internal courses and training, and a robust mentorship program.

- Chapters – You will join the community of intivers sharing the same professional profile. There is space for knowledge sharing with people with similar capabilities to yours and to access the latest technology trends.

- Culture & Connection – We cultivate connections within teams, across functions, and up and down the org chart. We make sure everyone is noticed and feels connected to our mission and each other

jobs_results.title: Senior Fullstack Developer NodeJs / ReactJs - Remote
jobs_results.description:
Job Description:
• Location: Fully remote, EU timezone (CET +/- 2hours)
• Start date: Mid-December
• Languages: English is mandatory; French is a plus

Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain the backend and front end of our marketplace application.
• Balance focus between backend and frontend development, with an initial emphasis on frontend tasks.
• Lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable features.

Qualifications:
• Expertise in React.js for frontend development.
• Strong background in Node.js environments for backend work.
• Familiarity with NestJS framework is highly advantageous.
• Experience with DigitalOcean, database management/design (e.g., PostgreSQL), and SQL queries is beneficial.
• Comfortable with TypeScript programming.
• Previous experience in a leadership role such as lead developer, architect, or senior developer is desirable.

What We Offer:
• Competitive salary based on your experience.
• Opportunity to work entirely remotely.
• Flexible working... hours in EU timezone.
• Continuous opportunities for learning and professional development.

Important Note: Only applications that closely match the job description will be considered. If your profile does not align with the specified criteria, you will not be shortlisted for this position

jobs_results.title: Nodejs backend software engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Role:
We are looking for a NodeJS Backend Software Engineer with excellent code quality. We offer you to participate in great, challenging and interesting projects. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills, problem-solving skills, and a passion for applying their expertise in the best way.

Responsibilities:
● Write efficient, reusable and self-documented code.
● Testing is in your mindset at any time (Units, acceptance...).
● Maintain the current platform so that the customer experience is seamless.
● Collaborate with other developers in team brainstorming, decision-making and architectural structures.
● Provide all necessary tasks completing which correlated not only to code writing but important for project configuration/setup/debug/devops.
● Deployment code to the live (customer) environment.
● Preparation of estimations of development efforts.
● Profiling project after being launched, taking care of telemetry and logging.

Requirements:
● Minimum of 3-5 years... Node.js (TypeScript) development experience.
● Proficiency in asynchronous systems (event-driven).
● Go is a plus.
● Voice assistant development (Alexa, google home...) is a plus.
● Experience with cache systems and other NoSQL (Redis preferred).
● Firm grasp of Git-based source control.
● Understanding of DDD/SOLID structure and development patterns.
● Testing ambassador.
● Competent with SQL database concepts (MySQL preferred).
● Comfort working with Linux-based systems and docker.
● AWS knowledge.
● Strong collaboration skills.
● Ability to work effectively, both independently and as a member of a team.
● Ability to think outside the box while identifying problems and developing creative solutions.
● Adaptable and eager to learn.
● English is a must.

Benefits:

- Remote Friendly
- Half-day Fridays!
- First class private health insurance after your first month.
- Online group training sessions twice a week & other out of office activities
- Free online language classes (Spanish & English) twice a week.
- Flexible compensation valid for restaurants & food delivery apps, transportation, childcare, and learning & development.
- Hundreds of discounts in different brands & services with the benefits platform of the company

Please submit your CV in English

jobs_results.title: Programador/a react-node
jobs_results.description:
En HAYS estamos colaborando con una importante empresa del sector de diseño de lámparas e iluminación para interiores fundada en 1979. Tiene más de 100 empleados y su sede se encuentra en Barcelona. Su misión es crear ambientes con estilo, utilizando la iluminación para aportar soluciones eficaces que tengan un impacto positivo en la vida de las personas.
Aspira a revolucionar el diseño de iluminación, desafiando sus reglas y proponiendo una nueva visión holística y aumentada que va más allá de la luz para integrar la materialidad, la composición y el uso del espacio.

Actualmente buscan un perfil de Programador/a React + Node para incorporarse a su equipo.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Seguir con la migración a microservicios.
Desarrollo de análisis y diseños técnicos a partir de las especificaciones de los requerimientos del negocio y documentación de análisis funcional.
Desarrollo de soluciones backend.
Analizar y proponer alternativas de implementación, aportando la visión... técnica desde el punto de vista del backend.

¿Cuáles son los requisitos?

Stack MERN.
Valorable React Native.
Metodología Scrum.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Proyecto estable.
Remoto 4 días semana.
Localización: Barcelona.
Horario de oficina.

Estamos esperando perfiles como el tuyo, apasionados con la tecnología y que quiera enfrentarse a un nuevo reto. Si es tu caso, inscríbete en la oferta para que podamos contarte más
